contract_now_verified_end_to_end.which_path: ParakeetProcessor.__call__, i.e. signal-level preemphasis 0.97 applied before the STFT, then mel, then log.
contract_now_verified_end_to_end.proof: Feeding the official __call__ features into the locally exported ONNX graph and greedily decoding with the model tokenizer reproduces the oracle transcript exactly: "And so, my fellow Americans, askk not what your country can do for you. Ask what you can do for your country."
contract_now_verified_end_to_end.control: The no-preemphasis path (_torch_extract_fbank_features) fed to the same graph decodes to "." only, so the earlier 7.40 measurement was against a contract the model does not consume.
contract_now_verified_end_to_end.preemphasis_semantics: torch.cat([x[:, :1], x[:, 1:] - preemphasis * x[:, :-1]]) with positions past audio_length zeroed, which matches our signal-level implementation (x[0] kept, x[i]-0.97*x[i-1]).

frontend_state.note: Window placement, window flavor, power spectra, log guard, center padding and the librosa filterbank are all verified individually; the residual is therefore upstream of mel, in the preemphasized signal or the STFT frame itself.

remaining_work: Compare our preemphasized float32 signal against the official one sample by sample, then compare the per-frame power spectra before mel. Stage-wise comparison localizes the break in one pass instead of inferring it from log-space feature deltas.
shipped: No preset, adapter or manifest registered. Two inert additive mel options remain, covered by tests/lasr-ctc-mel-filterbank-override.test.ts.
